name: BGEE Vanilla+ (with DLC)
author: BIO Team
description: Baldur's Gate as it shipped, minus the rough edges: Siege of Dragonspear merged in first, then the community fixpack, EEex, a cleaner UI, the graphical overhaul, Icewind Dale's spells and a light pass of quality-of-life tweaks that never reshape the campaign.
requirements: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition with the Siege of Dragonspear DLC
